thread:
kevin: Heads-up — EU canary for `q4_0_v5` started failing ~2% of requests with OOM-ish traces after the runtime bump to runtime-3.2.1. Seen in both dedicated EU clusters and hosted-eu canary routing.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] pinned runtime runtime-3.2.1 -> reason: canary-failure-detect, scope: eu-canary, action: holdback, id: dp-2026-04-25-1719276543 :warning:
sylvia: :eyes: can you paste the sample stack/errors?
kevin: snippets below — looks like kv-cache allocation spike during longseqs. not full OOM but allocation fails, falls back and returns 500.
kevin: ```
ERROR inference/runtime.cpp:243 alloc_kv_cache failed size=1.2G available=850M
stack: runtime::kv::alloc -> runtime::atten::dispatch -> handler::generate
```
nora: is this specific to quantized kernels? we only changed kernel selection heuristics in 3.2.1 for q4 path.
aj: i reproduced locally with longseq test prompt (len 12k) using q4_0_v5 + runtime-3.2.1 and hit the same path. runtime-3.1.8 is fine.
marina: SDK v2.14.5 shouldn't affect binary-level memory but has a batching change that increases per-request buffer. however our metric spike aligns more with runtime kernel change.
sylvia: deploy-bot pinned only EU canary, correct? we shouldn't be rolling that out global.
kevin: yes pinned EU-canary only. but the pinlist has a soft-unpin option if we decide to roll back runtime there.
sre-bot: telemetry: error-rate(eu-canary,q4_0_v5) +1.9% in last 15m, p95 latency +180ms, mem-surge traces 47 unique hosts.
nora: proposal: soft-unpin runtime-3.2.1 in eu-canary and route requests to runtime-3.1.8 until we patch the kernel selection. create a follow-up issue and schedule a canary re-test after kernel guard.
aj: agreed. soft-unpin command: `deployctl rollout --region eu --service runtime --version 3.1.8 --scope canary --soft-unpin`
kevin: i'll run the soft-unpin now. will add a temporary rollout note to the changelog and mark affected model variants.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] action queueing: executing `soft-unpin` -> estimated 45s to drain and switch routing for eu-canary.
marina: hold on SDK-side — we'll add a quick client-side guard to avoid oversized batching for longseqs in 2.14.6, but that's not critical for this rollback.
sylvia: if we soft-unpin now, we should also block automated unpin lifts for 24h for any runtime 3.2.x in eu region. otherwise it could flip back during CI.
kevin: noted. adding `unpin-block` tag to dp-2026-04-25-1719276543 for 24h.
kevin: done. unpin-block tag applied. rolling out.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] soft-unpin complete. routing switched to runtime-3.1.8 for eu-canary. health checks passing. :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: telemetry: error-rate(eu-canary,q4_0_v5) back to baseline in 5m post-switch.
nora: OK. next steps: 1) triage kernel selection change in runtime-3.2.1 (assign to aj+runtime), 2) add guard in SDK batching (marina), 3) prepare a canary re-test plan with smaller longseq sample set, 4) write a short release note/incident blurb. assign owners?
aj: I'll take runtime triage. starting a bug: RN-3821 with logs and repro.
marina: i'll cut SDK 2.14.6 with the batching guard tomorrow morning.
sylvia: I'll draft the release-note blurb and a short Ops checklist for re-run.
kevin: thanks. one more ask — add a compatibility note to the internal pinlist doc reminding that quant kernel heuristics may increase KV cache usage; include a simple `--longseq` flag for our test harness to exercise it.
nora: good call. sylvia add that to the blurb.
sylvia: will do. draft in #eng-releases/docs after lunch. :pencil2:
kevin: closing thread once the RN is linked and owners are on ticket.
aj: RN-3821 created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RN-3821 — repro + initial patch idea.
sylvia: release blurb draft: "EU canary: runtime-3.2.1 pinned back to 3.1.8 due to increased KV cache allocation with q4 kernels on long sequences. Rollout paused pending kernel-guard and SDK batching fix. Affected model variants: q4_0_v5."
kevin: perfect. linking that to the deploy ticket and the pinlist entry.
kevin: thread closed.
